notablePrerequisites: Your life total is at least 2.
description:
Cast Fraying Omnipotence by paying {3}{B}{B}, causing each opponent to lose their entire life total due to Bloodletter of Aclazotz, you to lose half your life total, and then causing each player to discard half their hand and sacrifice half the creatures they control.
Each opponent loses the game due to having 0 or less life.
